rows.activity: Capture the week's layer KPI inputs.
rows.data: Week start/end; flock_id; house_id; lot_id; opening birds; transfers in/out; mortality count; feed kg; water L; marketable, cracked and dirty egg counts.
rows.comment: Require active flock/house/lot and one record per flock, house and week. Keep dates ISO-8601 in storage with DD/MM/YYYY display and Africa/Lagos timestamps. Preserve creator and source references.

rows.data: Closing and average live birds; egg production rate; mortality rate; feed per live bird; total eggs; crates and loose eggs.
rows.comment: Use configurable farm-reviewed formulas, denominators, rounding and crate capacity. Keep whole-egg counts and formula version; flag missing or inconsistent values without fixed biological thresholds.

rows.data: Review status; reviewer and time; exceptions; review note; medicine withdrawal hold; affected flock/lot; hold-until date.
rows.comment: Check source totals, mortality and lot identity. Use recorded veterinary product, batch, expiry and label withdrawal data to flag affected output; return discrepancies with a reason and retain review history.

rows.data: Approval status; approver and time; posting status; notification result.
rows.comment: Approve after review and disposition of exceptions. Lock approved version except audited correction; do not release output under an active withdrawal hold. Notify configured roles.

rows.activity: Record the daily brooder operations entry.
rows.data: Date; house_id; flock/lot; opening chicks; feed kg; water L; temperature °C; humidity %; mortality; culls; observations; biosecurity check; recorder.
rows.comment: Require active flock/house/lot and non-negative counts. Warn or block duplicate house, flock and date submissions unless audited correction is used. Store ISO dates and Africa/Lagos audit times.

rows.data: Estimated live birds; mortality rate; feed per bird; water per bird; validation status; exception codes.
rows.comment: Use configurable farm/veterinary-approved formulas and thresholds. Flag count mismatch, missing observation or incomplete biosecurity check; do not silently replace source values.

rows.data: Review status; reviewer; time; review note; mortality disposition; dead-bird handling; movement reference.
rows.comment: Require a reason for return or exception. Preserve original values and reviewer history; capture handling or movement references for flock/lot traceability.

rows.data: Approval status; approver; time; medicine name/ingredient; registration identifier; batch; manufacture/expiry dates; label withdrawal period and end date.
rows.comment: When medicine is recorded, validate label identity, batch, dates and withdrawal period; flag affected flock/lot. Keep treatment rules configurable for veterinary review; audit every decision.

rows.data: Posting status; timestamp; ledger reference; notification status.
rows.comment: Post once using an idempotency key; link house, flock and lot; retain immutable status history and notify the attendant/supervisor.

rows.activity: Submit the weekly brooder KPI record.
rows.data: Week start; house_id; flock/lot; chick age; opening chicks; receipts; deaths; culls; closing chicks; feed kg; water L; average weight g.
rows.comment: Require active house and lot, non-negative inputs and week within placement period. Save as draft; flag duplicate house, lot and week records for authorized resolution.

rows.data: Mortality rate; feed per live bird; average weight change; count reconciliation; formula version.
rows.comment: Calculate counts from openings, receipts, deaths and culls; compare with entered closing count. Keep formulas and biological thresholds configurable for farm/veterinary review.

rows.data: Status; reviewer; time; exception code; note; linked feed/bird movement/vaccine/medicine records.
rows.comment: Check count mismatch, mortality, flock/lot traceability and treatment details. Return with a reason; show any active withdrawal flag for veterinary review.

rows.data: Decision; approver; time; approval note; posting time.
rows.comment: Approve only after review and disposition of blocking exceptions. Preserve version history; post only the approved record and notify the brooder supervisor.

rows.data: Date; flock/lot; house; age days; sample count; individual weights g; scale_id; attendant.
rows.comment: Require active flock/lot, non-negative weights, and sample count matching weight entries. Flag duplicate flock, lot, house and week records; retain user/time audit history.

rows.data: Mean, minimum and maximum weight; sample count; change from prior week.
rows.comment: Calculate from submitted weights and prior approved record. Keep alert thresholds configurable for farm/veterinary review; treat missing inputs as errors, not zero.

rows.data: Status; reviewer; time; review note; mortality linkage; medicine withdrawal status.
rows.comment: Return corrections with a reason and preserve history. Show lot identity and relevant mortality or withdrawal flags as context; do not alter those source records.

rows.data: Decision; approver; time; approval note.
rows.comment: Approve only after validation and supervisor review. Require a reason for rejection and notify the attendant.

rows.data: Posting status; source record; flock/lot; mean weight; sample count.
rows.comment: Post approved version once; keep source link and posting error log; allow correction only through an audited version.

rows.activity: Record the daily flock operations log.
rows.data: Date; farm/house; flock/lot; opening birds; feed issued kg; water L; mortality; culls; observations.
rows.comment: Require date, house and lot; flag duplicate daily records and counts above opening population. Use an audited correction workflow and retain lot traceability.

rows.activity: Log flock treatment and vaccination details.
rows.data: Activity; product and active ingredient; batch; manufacture/expiry; dose/unit; route; administration date; label withdrawal period/end date; veterinarian.
rows.comment: Validate label identity, batch and dates when supplied. Apply withdrawal flags using recorded label period and farm/veterinary-reviewed rule; do not hard-code thresholds.

rows.data: Mortality rate; feed and water per bird; formula version; validation flags.
rows.comment: Use configurable formula and denominators. Notify supervisor of missing, conflicting or configured out-of-range values; preserve calculation inputs.

rows.data: Status; reviewer/time; review note; exception; withdrawal status.
rows.comment: Return incomplete entries with reason. Display biosecurity notes and medicine restrictions; retain status history and role-restricted staff identifiers.

rows.data: Record id; posting status; actor/time; audit reference.
rows.comment: Post only approved version once. Lock direct edits; route corrections through audited amendment and notify configured roles.

rows.activity: Record the weekly flock KPI inputs.
rows.data: Week; flock/house/lot; opening birds; placements; deaths; culls; closing birds; feed kg; water L; sample weight kg/count.
rows.comment: Require valid dates and active lot; reject duplicate flock/week submissions. Keep ISO date storage and Africa/Lagos audit timestamps; retain source and staff references.

rows.data: Closing count; mortality rate; average weight; feed per bird; water per bird; formula version.
rows.comment: Calculate from source counts; flag mismatch and invalid denominators. Keep formulas and biological thresholds configurable; never silently overwrite inputs.

rows.data: Status; reviewer/time; exception; comment; mortality reference; biosecurity reference; treatment withdrawal end.
rows.comment: Check traceability, deaths, culls and medicine records. Return with reason; show active withdrawal status for linked sales/dispatch review.

rows.data: Decision; approver/time; approval note; record version.
rows.comment: Approve after review and disposition of blocking exceptions. Preserve versions and rejection reasons; restrict staff data by role.

rows.data: Posting status; posted record id/time; final version; notification result.
rows.comment: Post approved version once with an idempotency check; retain flock/house/lot link and audited correction pathway.

rows.data: Week/date; flock/lot; house/pen; assigned attendant; due date.
rows.comment: Require active flock and lot. Prevent duplicate open task for same flock/pen/week unless an authorized reason is recorded.

rows.activity: Record sampled bird weights by pen.
rows.data: Date; flock/lot; house/pen; sample count; individual weights g; scale id; hygiene confirmation.
rows.comment: Require sample count to match entries and valid non-negative weights. Keep sample-size alerts configurable and retain prior values for corrections.

rows.activity: Calculate pen and flock weight summaries.
rows.data: Sample count; pen mean; flock mean; formula version.
rows.comment: Calculate from recorded weights and preserve precision. Keep review warning settings configurable; flag missing lot links and invalid inputs.

rows.data: Review status; reviewer/time; note; linked mortality context.
rows.comment: Return for correction with a reason; retain reviewer history and do not alter mortality records.

rows.data: Decision; approver/time; posted time; final means.
rows.comment: Approve after validation and review. Preserve flock/lot traceability, post once and notify attendant/supervisor.

rows.data: Flock/house; feed type; date range; planned quantity kg; reason; requester.
rows.comment: Require active flock, positive quantity and valid dates. Save as draft; record staff identity and Africa/Lagos timestamp.

rows.data: Planned days; expected daily use kg; projected need; available stock; shortfall; formula version.
rows.comment: Use farm-configured consumption assumptions; do not hard-code biological values. Flag stale stock or missing assumptions.

rows.activity: Submit the feed plan for review.
rows.data: Plan id; flock; feed type; quantity; delivery date; supplier and reviewer.
rows.comment: Require complete flock link and designated reviewer. Validate Nigerian supplier State/LGA/phone fields where captured; prevent duplicate active submission and notify reviewer.

rows.data: Decision; approved kg; approver/time; variance note.
rows.comment: Require authorized approver and reason for quantity variance. Approval does not post stock; rejection requires reason and notifies planner.

rows.data: Date; flock; feed type/lot; requested kg; required date; requester; purpose.
rows.comment: Require positive quantity and active flock; flag duplicate open requests by flock, type and date. Retain requester/timestamp.

rows.data: Requested, available and reserved kg; net order kg; estimated NGN unit and total price.
rows.comment: Subtract usable unreserved stock; exclude expired/quarantined lots. Display NGN and store monetary values in kobo-safe precision.

rows.data: Decision; approved quantity; reviewer/time; reason; note.
rows.comment: Require reason for return/rejection or quantity change. Keep unapproved requests out of purchasing; record status history.

rows.activity: Post the approved requisition to the supplier order register.
rows.data: PO; supplier and Nigerian contact; feed type; order kg; price NGN; order/expected delivery dates.
rows.comment: Post approved requisition once. Match receipt to PO and supplier lot; route delivery discrepancies or suspect feed to quarantine.

rows.data: Date/time; supplier/contact; PO; delivery note; SKU/type; delivered kg; lot; manufacture/expiry; vehicle/hygiene notes.
rows.comment: Require positive quantity and delivery evidence. Flag duplicate supplier/delivery-note/PO references; quarantine wet, damaged, contaminated or unidentified feed.

rows.data: Ordered and delivered kg; variance kg/%; unit cost NGN; line total kobo.
rows.comment: Calculate only with valid nonzero order quantity. Use configurable tolerance and record calculation inputs.

rows.data: Decision; approved/quarantined kg; quality disposition; reviewer/time; reason.
rows.comment: Approve, reject or quarantine with reason. Keep quarantined quantity unavailable; verify feed identity, lot and dates; notify storekeeper.

rows.activity: Post the approved receipt to inventory.
rows.data: Receipt/lot; posted, usable and quarantined kg; unit cost; location; actor/time.
rows.comment: Post once using unique transaction id; update lot balances and preserve receipt/approval audit trail.

rows.data: Date; requester; recipient/unit; feed item/lot; requested kg; purpose; required date.
rows.comment: Generate unique request id, validate positive quantity and prevent duplicate submission. Set Pending Review and notify inventory officer.

rows.data: Available lot kg; requested/approved kg; location; reviewer/time; note.
rows.comment: Verify traceable active lot and sufficient unreserved stock. Return incomplete requests with reason; do not allow negative balance.

rows.data: Decision; approved kg; approver/time; approval note.
rows.comment: Require authorized role and reason for rejection or quantity change. Preserve decision audit and notify requester/storekeeper.

rows.data: Issue id; item/lot; issued kg; recipient; location; flock/lot if applicable; balance after.
rows.comment: Post once; validate approved amount and stock; create immutable lot-linked movement. Flag medicated feed restrictions for veterinary review when relevant.

rows.activity: Record feed consumption for a flock.
rows.data: Date; flock/house; feed item/lot; issued kg; returned kg; consumed kg; operator; hygiene note.
rows.comment: Validate consumed = issued less returned and non-negative quantities. Prevent duplicate flock/house/date/lot submission; save as draft with audit trail.

rows.data: Record id; lot; quantities; status; reviewer/time; exception reason.
rows.comment: Compare with issue ledger and flock assignment. Return duplicate, inconsistent or incomplete entries with reason.

rows.data: Decision; approver/time; approval comment.
rows.comment: Approve after review; rejected records do not affect stock. Keep decision audit and notify operator.

rows.data: Lot; consumed kg; remaining balance; posting time/status; notification result.
rows.comment: Decrement stock once; block insufficient/inactive lot balance. Calculate variance only against farm-configured ration plan and thresholds.

rows.data: Week start/end; flock/lot; eligible laying birds; requester/time.
rows.comment: Require active flock/lot and valid farm week; prevent duplicate open forecast for same week and lot. Store dates ISO-8601 and display DD/MM/YYYY.

rows.data: Eligible birds; configurable lay rate; forecast days; projected eggs; crate capacity and crates; withdrawal exclusions.
rows.comment: Use farm-approved configurable formula and crate capacity. Exclude output subject to recorded medicine withdrawal; flag missing traceability or treatment data; do not hard-code thresholds.

rows.data: Version; projected eggs/crates; exclusions; decision; reviewer/time; note.
rows.comment: Require decision and reviewer identity. Return unresolved inputs for change; preserve versions and audit history.

rows.data: Forecast/version; posting status; actor/time; projected eggs/crates.
rows.comment: Post approved version once without changing actual stock; notify inventory and production roles.

rows.data: Date/time; flock/house/egg lot; collector; eggs collected; cracked/dirty eggs; crates; feed lot if relevant.
rows.comment: Require whole nonnegative counts; store ISO dates and Africa/Lagos time. Flag duplicate date/flock/house/lot record; use audited correction.

rows.activity: Calculate saleable egg and crate totals.
rows.data: Gross, nonmarketable and saleable eggs; configurable crate capacity; crate equivalent.
rows.comment: Preserve whole egg counts; crate capacity is farm-configurable. Keep formula inputs and calculations for audit.

rows.data: Record/flock/lot; mortality; treatment product/batch; withdrawal end; review note.
rows.comment: Verify traceability and applicable label withdrawal data; hold affected eggs while withdrawal is active. Return discrepancies with reason.

rows.data: Status; approver/time; approval note.
rows.comment: Approve only after required fields and checks pass; returned records stay out of stock posting.

rows.activity: Post the approved record to egg inventory.
rows.data: Inventory transaction; saleable eggs/crates; Available/Held status; time.
rows.comment: Post once using idempotent transaction; keep withdrawal-restricted stock Held and notify inventory role.

rows.activity: Enter the daily egg inventory record.
rows.data: Date/shift; house/flock/egg lot; opening; collected; cracked; dirty; dispatched; physical closing eggs; crate capacity.
rows.comment: Require whole counts and biosecurity note; flag duplicate date/shift/house/flock/lot. Keep eggs, crates and date representation consistent.

rows.activity: Calculate expected closing stock and crate equivalents.
rows.data: Opening + receipts - dispatches - breakage/disposal; physical close; variance eggs; crate equivalent.
rows.comment: Define whether dirty eggs remain held or are disposed; do not deduct dirty eggs twice. Use configurable crate capacity and flag negative balance or variance for review.

rows.data: Expected/physical closing; variance; flock/lot; withdrawal status; biosecurity; reviewer/time.
rows.comment: Reconcile collection and dispatch records. Resolve or return discrepancy and withdrawal exceptions before approval; retain audit history.

rows.data: Decision; approver/time; posted closing eggs; notification status.
rows.comment: Approve after review; update stock once and keep withdrawal-ineligible quantities out of saleable stock. Record amendments as new audited versions.

rows.activity: Record the annual production plan request.
rows.data: Plan year; site; breed/strain; requested start date; planned cycles; requester.
rows.comment: Use unique site and plan-year key; prevent duplicate active plan. Display dates DD/MM/YYYY, store ISO-8601 and retain audit trail.

rows.data: Cycle/date; breed; planned birds; supplier/source lot; mortality assumption; feed kg; vaccination plan; estimated NGN cost.
rows.comment: Require lot/source references where known. Keep biological assumptions configurable for farm/veterinary review and cost values kobo-safe.

rows.data: Annual placements; projected survivors; feed kg; projected NGN cost; formula version.
rows.comment: Use configured assumptions; mark missing source or review data as unresolved. Treat projections as estimates, not guaranteed output.

rows.data: Status; reviewer/time; notes; revised birds/cost; exceptions.
rows.comment: Return incomplete or unresolved traceability/biosecurity inputs with reason; preserve prior versions and recalculation history.

rows.data: Decision; approver/time; approved placements; NGN budget; notification status.
rows.comment: Approve current reviewed version once; retain immutable decision history and notify planner. Require authorized superseding version for changes.

rows.data: Date; bird type/strain/age/sex; quantity; delivery date; supplier; +234 phone; State/LGA.
rows.comment: Require positive whole bird count and valid dates/contact formats. Flag likely duplicate supplier/type/quantity orders; retain creator/time.

rows.data: Decision; approved quantity; supplier; delivery date; reviewer/time; note.
rows.comment: Require authorized approver; return/reject with reason. Block receipt against an unapproved request and notify requester.

rows.data: PO/delivery note; origin; vehicle; supplier flock/lot; ordered/received/dead-on-arrival birds; condition; biosecurity check.
rows.comment: Match approved request and supplier. Record transport/biosecurity observations and route condition/count concerns for veterinary review; keep exception thresholds configurable.

rows.data: Receipt; supplier lot; accepted/dead-on-arrival counts; house/pen; internal flock/lot; actor/time.
rows.comment: Post accepted quantity once; retain supplier and internal lot lineage. Keep exceptions pending review and notify manager/requester.

rows.data: Flock/lot; source and destination house/pen; requested birds; reason; planned time; vehicle/handler.
rows.comment: Require distinct source/destination and available stock. Store ISO dates/times with Africa/Lagos display and retain staff audit.

rows.data: Available birds; source mortality; active treatment/withdrawal; vehicle cleaning; biosecurity status.
rows.comment: Flag duplicate pending transfer, insufficient stock or missing movement checks. Carry lot/withdrawal status; keep thresholds configurable.

rows.data: Transport/movement reference; vehicle cleaning; mortality reconciliation; reviewer/time; note.
rows.comment: Require movement/transport details and documented checks under farm procedure; return unexplained differences with reason.

rows.data: Decision; approver/time; rejection reason.
rows.comment: Approve after required checks pass; restrict approval by role and retain status history.

rows.data: Actual time; transferred birds; source/destination balances; destination flock/lot; notification.
rows.comment: Post atomically once; preserve lineage and route actual-count variance for review. Notify source/destination staff.

rows.data: Customer; product; flock/lot; quantity/unit; delivery date/window; address State/LGA; phone.
rows.comment: Validate positive quantity and Nigerian State/LGA/phone fields when provided. Restrict customer contact data by role; flag duplicate active requests.

rows.data: On-hand/reserved/planned quantity; product/lot; unit; crate capacity; withdrawal clearance.
rows.comment: Exclude quarantined or withdrawal-blocked lots. Preserve flock/lot traceability; configure safety buffers rather than hard-code thresholds.

rows.data: Request; proposed date/window; quantity; availability; exceptions; reviewer/time.
rows.comment: Flag shortages, blocked lots and overlapping slots. Return for changes with reason and retain audit trail.

rows.data: Approved quantity/date/window; customer price NGN; decision; approver/time.
rows.comment: Validate quantity against availability or require documented override. Store NGN in kobo-safe precision and preserve approval history.

rows.data: Schedule; customer; product/lot; quantity; delivery date; reservation; notification result.
rows.comment: Reserve stock once; keep status history and retry notifications without duplicate reservations.

rows.data: Sale date/reference; product; flock/lot; quantity/unit; unit price NGN; customer/contact; State/LGA; payment method/reference.
rows.comment: Require unique transaction reference, positive quantity/price and saleable traceable lot. Validate configurable crate capacity; restrict customer data by role.

rows.data: Quantity/unit; unit price; line total NGN and kobo; currency code.
rows.comment: Use decimal-safe arithmetic and kobo-safe storage; display NGN/Naira. Keep tax/VAT fields configurable pending finance review.

rows.data: Transaction; lot; quantity; total; decision; reviewer/time.
rows.comment: Check duplicate reference, stock availability and quarantine/withdrawal status. Return exceptions with reason; preserve status and actor history.

rows.data: Posting status/time; inventory movement reference; total kobo; notification.
rows.comment: Post only approved entry once using idempotency; decrement stock atomically and keep flock/lot linkage. Retain audit trail and notify configured role.
